201: ਮਇਆ ਕਰੀ; ਪੂਰਨ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
the Perfect Lord King has shown His mercy. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਜਾ ਕੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਭਾਗ ॥
Says Nanak, one whose destiny is perfect
meditates on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, his eternal Husband. ॥2॥106॥
Taking off his loincloth, he spreads it out beneath him,
and stuffs his belly like a donkey. ॥1॥
Without good deeds, liberation is not obtained.
The wealth of liberation comes only by meditating on the Name. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
He performs worship, applies the ceremonial mark and takes his cleansing baths;
then he pulls out a knife and demands donations. ॥2॥
With his mouth he recites the Vedas in sweet tones,
yet he does not hesitate to slaughter (deceive) living beings. ॥3॥
Says Nanak, when God showers His mercy,
even the heart is purified, and one contemplates God. ॥4॥107॥
ਥਿਰੁ ਘਰਿ ਬੈਸਹੁ; ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
Remain steady in your own home, O beloved servants of the Lord;
the True Guru has resolved your affairs. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The Transcendent Lord has struck down the wicked and the evil;
the Creator has preserved the honour of His servant. ॥1॥
ਬਾਦਿਸਾਹ ਸਾਹ ਸਭ; ਵਸਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨੇ ॥
He has made all kings and emperors subject to (His servants);
they have drunk deeply of the supreme essence of the Ambrosial Name. ॥2॥
Meditate fearlessly on the Lord God.
Joining the holy company, this gift is given. ॥3॥
Nanak has entered the sanctuary of God, the Searcher of hearts;
he has grasped the support of God, his Lord and Master. ॥4॥108॥
ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ; ਭਾਹਿ. ਨ ਜਲੈ ॥
One who is attuned to the Lord does not burn in the fire.
ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ; ਮਾਇਆ ਨਹੀ ਛਲੈ ॥
One who is attuned to the Lord is not enticed by Maya.
ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ; ਨਹੀ ਡੂਬੈ ਜਲਾ ॥
One who is attuned to the Lord does not drown in the water.
One who is attuned to the Lord is prosperous and fruitful. ॥1॥
All fear is erased by Your Name.
ਭੇਟਤ ਸੰਗਿ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Joining the company (of the holy), one sings the praises of the Lord, Har, Har. ॥ Rahao ॥
ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ; ਮਿਟੈ ਸਭ ਚਿੰਤਾ ॥
One who is attuned to the Lord is free of all anxiety.
ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਸੋ ਰਚੈ; ਜਿਸੁ ਸਾਧ ਕਾ ਮੰਤਾ ॥
He alone is attuned to the Lord, who is blessed with the mantra of the Holy.
ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ; ਜਮ ਕੀ ਨਹੀ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ॥
One who is attuned to the Lord is not haunted by the fear of death.
One who is attuned to the Lord has his hopes fulfilled. ॥2॥
ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ; ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
One who is attuned to the Lord does not suffer in pain.
One who is attuned to the Lord remains awake night and day.
ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ; ਸਹਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਸੈ ॥
One who is attuned to the Lord dwells in the home of poise.
ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ; ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਨਸੈ ॥੩॥
One who is attuned to the Lord is rid of doubt and fear. ॥3॥
ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ; ਮਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਹੋਇ ॥
One who is attuned to the Lord has the most sublime intellect.
One who is attuned to the Lord has a pure reputation.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to those
ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ; ਬਿਸਰਤ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੪॥੧੦੯॥
Through earnest effort (to join the holy), the mind becomes calm.
Walking on this path, all pain is taken away.
Chanting the Name, the mind becomes blissful,
singing with love the praises of the Lord of supreme bliss. ॥1॥
Joy has welled up, and peace has come to my home.
Joining the holy company, the evil has vanished. ॥ Rahao ॥
My eyes are purified, beholding His Blessed Vision.
ਧਨਿ ਮਸਤਕ; ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਹੀ ਪਰਸ ॥
Blessed is the forehead that touches His lotus feet.
ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਕੀ ਟਹਲ; ਸਫਲ ਇਹ ਕਾਂਇਆ ॥
Working for the Lord of the Universe, this body becomes fruitful.
202: By the grace of the saints, the supreme state is obtained. ॥2॥
The Lord Himself has helped His humble servant;
he has found peace, falling at the feet of His slaves.
When self-conceit is gone, one becomes like Him;
he has entered the sanctuary of the Treasure of mercy. ॥3॥
When one obtains what one longs for,
why should one go searching anywhere else?
One becomes steady and dwells in the seat of peace;
by the Guru's grace, O Nanak, one dwells in peace. ॥4॥110॥
(It is as if) he has taken cleansing baths at millions of places of pilgrimage,
and given hundreds of thousands, billions and trillions in charity —
ਜਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਓ; ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥
the one within whose mind the Lord's Name abides. ॥1॥
All are made pure by singing the praises of the Lord of the world.
ਪਾਪ ਮਿਟਹਿ; ਸਾਧੂ ਸਰਨਿ ਦਇਆਲ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Sins are erased in the sanctuary of the kind and compassionate Holy Guru. ॥ Rahao ॥
(It is as if) he has practised all sorts of austerities, hanging upside down,
and gained countless benefits and fulfilled his desires —
the one who worships the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, with his tongue. ॥2॥
(It is as if) he has recited the Smritis, Shastras and Vedas,
and known the peace of Yoga, spiritual wisdom and the Siddhas —
ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਉ ਮਨ ਮਾਨੇ ॥੩॥
the one whose mind, chanting the Name, is won over by God. ॥3॥
The Lord, of unfathomable wisdom, is inaccessible and infinite;
chanting the Name, one reflects on the Name in the heart.
O God, shower Your mercy on Nanak. ॥4॥111॥
Remembering, remembering, remembering Him, I have found peace;
I have enshrined the Guru's lotus feet in my heart. ॥1॥
The Guru, the Lord of the Universe, is the Perfect Supreme Lord God.
ਤਿਸਹਿ ਅਰਾਧਿ; ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Worshipping Him, my mind has become steady. ॥ Rahao ॥
Night and day, I meditate on the Name of the Guru, the Guru;
ਤਾ ਤੇ; ਸਿਧਿ ਭਏ ਸਗਲ ਕਾਂਮ ॥੨॥
thus all my works are brought to perfection. ॥2॥
Beholding His Blessed Vision, my mind has become cool,
and the sins of countless births are gone. ॥3॥
Says Nanak, where is fear now, O brother?
ਅਪਨੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ; ਆਪਿ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਈ ॥੪॥੧੧੨॥
He Himself has preserved the honour of His servant. ॥4॥112॥
He Himself is the helper of His servant;
He ever cherishes him, like father and mother. ॥1॥
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਿ; ਉਬਰੈ ਸਭ ਕੋਇ ॥
In God's sanctuary, everyone is saved.
ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ; ਪੂਰਨ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
He is the Doer, the Cause of causes, the Perfect True Lord. ॥ Rahao ॥
Now the Creator Lord dwells in my mind;
my fears are dispelled, and I have found the peace of the soul. ॥2॥
Granting His grace, He has saved His humble servants;
the sins of countless births are washed away. ॥3॥
ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
The greatness of God cannot be described;
slave Nanak remains forever in His sanctuary. ॥4॥113॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
The Lord's power is all-pervading, O brother,
ਤਾ ਤੇ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ; ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਕਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
so no affliction touches (His servant). ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜੋ ਜੋ ਚਿਤਵੈ; ਦਾਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਈ ॥
Whatever the Lord's slave wishes for, O mother,
the Creator Himself causes it to be done. ॥1॥
God has taken away the honour of the slanderers.
Nanak sings the praises of the Lord fearlessly. ॥2॥114॥
203: ਭੁਜ ਬਲ ਬੀਰ. ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਗਰਤ ਪਰਤ ਗਹਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਅੰਗੁਰੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O mighty-armed hero, O God, Ocean of peace, I am falling into the pit; take hold of my finger. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸ੍ਰਵਨਿ. ਨ ਸੁਰਤਿ, ਨੈਨ. ਸੁੰਦਰ ਨਹੀ; ਆਰਤ ਦੁਆਰਿ, ਰਟਤ ਪਿੰਗੁਰੀਆ ॥੧॥
My ears do not hear, my eyes are not beautiful (to behold You); afflicted and crippled, I cry out at Your door. ॥1॥
ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥ. ਅਨਾਥ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮੈ; ਸਾਜਨ ਮੀਤ. ਪਿਤਾ ਮਹਤਰੀਆ ॥
O Master of the meek, Merciful to the helpless, my Friend, Companion, Father and Mother —
ਚਰਨ ਕਵਲ. ਹਿਰਦੈ ਗਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ; ਭੈ ਸਾਗਰ. ਸੰਤ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਰੀਆ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੧੫॥
O Nanak, holding Your lotus feet in their hearts, the saints cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ॥2॥2॥115॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਦਯ ਗੁਸਾਈ ਮੀਤੁਲਾ; ਤੂੰ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਬਾਸੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O merciful Lord of the world, my dear Friend, please dwell with me. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ. ਘਰੀ ਨ ਜੀਵਨਾ; ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਰਹਣਾ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
Without You I cannot live for even a moment; cursed is life in this world (without You).
ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਿਆ; ਨਿਮਖ ਨਿਮਖ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਿ ਜੀ ॥੧॥
O Giver of soul, breath and peace, each and every moment I am a sacrifice to You. ॥1॥
ਹਸਤ ਅਲੰਬਨੁ. ਦੇਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਗਰਤਹੁ. ਉਧਰੁ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥
Give me the support of Your hand, O God; lift me up out of the pit, O Lord of the world.
ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ. ਮਤਿ ਥੋਰੀਆ; ਤੂੰ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ॥੨॥
I am without virtue, with shallow intellect; You are ever merciful to the meek. ॥2॥
ਕਿਆ ਸੁਖ ਤੇਰੇ ਸੰਮਲਾ; ਕਵਨ ਬਿਧੀ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥
What comforts of Yours can I recall? How can I reflect on You?
ਸਰਣਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਦਾਸ ਹਿਤ; ਊਚੇ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰ ॥੩॥
You are the sanctuary of those who seek You, the lover of Your slaves, lofty, inaccessible and infinite. ॥3॥
ਸਗਲ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਅਸਟ ਸਿਧਿ; ਨਾਮ ਮਹਾ ਰਸ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
All treasures and the eight spiritual powers are in the supreme essence of the Name.
ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਭਏ ਕੇਸਵਾ; ਸੇ ਜਨ. ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਹਿ ॥੪॥
Those humble beings with whom the long-haired Lord is pleased sing the Lord's praises. ॥4॥
ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਬੰਧਪੋ; ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਅਧਾਰ ॥
You are my mother, father, son and relative; You are the support of my breath of life.
ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਭਜੈ; ਬਿਖੁ ਤਰਿਆ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੫॥੧॥੧੧੬॥
In the holy company, Nanak meditates on You and crosses over the poisonous world-ocean. ॥5॥1॥116॥
ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਰਹੋਏ ਕੇ ਛੰਤ ਕੇ ਘਰਿ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
Is there anyone who sings of the Beloved Lord?
ਸਰਬ ਕਲਿਆਣ; ਸੂਖ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
He obtains all comforts and peace, and the True One. ॥ Rahao ॥
The renunciate goes searching from forest to forest;
but only a rare few are lovingly attuned to the One.
Those who have found the Lord are very fortunate. ॥1॥
Brahma and the other gods, and Sanak and his brothers, long for Him;
the yogis, celibates and Siddhas long for the Lord;
ਜਿਸਹਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ; ਸੋ. ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਹੈ ॥੨॥
but only the one so blessed sings the Lord's praises. ॥2॥
ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ; ਜਿਨ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Seek the sanctuary of those who do not forget Him.
Only the very fortunate meet the Lord's saints.
They are not subject to birth and death at all. ॥3॥
Show Your mercy and meet me, O my Beloved.
Hear my prayer, O lofty, infinite God:
Nanak begs for the support of Your Name. ॥4॥1॥117॥
204: One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਕਵਨ ਗੁਨ; ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤਿ ਮਿਲਉ. ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Through what virtues can I meet the Lord, the Master of my breath of life, O my mother? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਰੂਪ ਹੀਨ. ਬੁਧਿ ਬਲ ਹੀਨੀ; ਮੋਹਿ ਪਰਦੇਸਨਿ. ਦੂਰ ਤੇ ਆਈ ॥੧॥
I have no beauty, no understanding, no strength; I am a stranger, come from far away. ॥1॥
ਨਾਹਿਨ ਦਰਬੁ. ਨ ਜੋਬਨ ਮਾਤੀ; ਮੋਹਿ ਅਨਾਥ ਕੀ. ਕਰਹੁ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੨॥
I have no wealth, nor the intoxication of youth; I am helpless — unite me with Yourself. ॥2॥
ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਭਈ ਬੈਰਾਗਨਿ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਉ. ਹਉ ਫਿਰਤ ਤਿਸਾਈ ॥੩॥
Searching and searching, I have become a renunciate; I wander about thirsting for the Blessed Vision of God. ॥3॥
ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਨਕ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਲਨਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੧੮॥
O God, merciful and compassionate to the meek, (says) Nanak, in the holy company my burning has been quenched. ॥4॥1॥118॥
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲਬੇ ਕਉ; ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
Love for meeting God has welled up in my mind.
ਪਾਇ ਲਗਉ. ਮੋਹਿ ਕਰਉ ਬੇਨਤੀ; ਕੋਊ ਸੰਤੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਬਡਭਾਗੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I would fall at the feet of, and pray to, any fortunate saint I might meet. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਮਨੁ ਅਰਪਉ. ਧਨੁ ਰਾਖਉ ਆਗੈ; ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ. ਮੋਹਿ ਸਗਲ ਤਿਆਗੀ ॥
I would surrender my mind to him and place my wealth before him; I have renounced all the cleverness of my mind.
ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਨਾਵੈ; ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਫਿਰਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਿਛੈ ਵਿਰਾਗੀ ॥੧॥
One who recites to me the discourse of the Lord God — night and day, I would follow him about, in loving detachment. ॥1॥
ਪੂਰਬ ਕਰਮ ਅੰਕੁਰ ਜਬ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੇ; ਭੇਟਿਓ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਰਸਿਕ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥
When the sprouts of past deeds sprang forth, I met the Lord, the Enjoyer and yet detached.
ਮਿਟਿਓ ਅੰਧੇਰੁ. ਮਿਲਤ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ; ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਗੀ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੧੯॥
My darkness was dispelled meeting the Lord, O Nanak; asleep for countless births, I have awakened. ॥2॥2॥119॥
ਨਿਕਸੁ ਰੇ ਪੰਖੀ; ਸਿਮਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਂਖ ॥
Come out, O bird-soul, and let remembrance of the Lord be your wings.
ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ. ਸਰਣਿ ਗਹੁ ਪੂਰਨ; ਰਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਹੀਅਰੇ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਖੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Meet the Holy, seek the sanctuary of the Perfect One, and keep the jewel of the Lord's Name close to your heart. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕੀ ਕੂਈ. ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਰਸ ਪੰਕਜ; ਅਤਿ ਤੀਖੵਣ. ਮੋਹ ਕੀ ਫਾਸ ॥
Doubt is the well, craving for pleasure is the mud, and the noose of attachment is very tight.
ਕਾਟਨਹਾਰ ਜਗਤ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਬਿਦ; ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਕਰਹੁ ਨਿਵਾਸ ॥੧॥
Only the Guru of the world, the Lord of the Universe, can cut it; dwell at His lotus feet. ॥1॥
ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ; ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
Show mercy, O Lord of the Universe, O God, my Beloved, Master of the meek; please hear my prayer.
ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਲੇਹੁ. ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥੨॥੩॥੧੨੦॥
Take hold of my hand, O Lord of Nanak; my soul and body are all Your capital. ॥2॥3॥120॥
ਹਰਿ ਪੇਖਨ ਕਉ; ਸਿਮਰਤ ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
My mind longs to behold the Lord, remembering Him.
ਆਸ ਪਿਆਸੀ. ਚਿਤਵਉ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨੀ; ਹੈ ਕੋਈ ਸੰਤੁ. ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਨੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Thirsting with hope, I think of Him day and night; is there any saint who can bring Him near to me? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਉ. ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੀ; ਅਨਿਕ ਭਾਂਤਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਰਉ ਨਿਹੋਰਾ ॥
I would serve the slaves of His slaves; I would plead with Him in so many ways.
ਤੁਲਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਤੋਲੇ ਸੁਖ ਸਗਲੇ; ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸ. ਸਭੋ ਹੀ ਥੋਰਾ ॥੧॥
Placing them on the scale, I have weighed all comforts; without the Blessed Vision of the Lord, they are all too little. ॥1॥
ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਗਾਏ ਗੁਨ ਸਾਗਰ; ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੋ ਜਾਤ ਬਹੋਰਾ ॥
By the grace of the saints, I sing the praises of the Ocean of virtue; after so many births of wandering, I have been brought back.
ਆਨਦ ਸੂਖ ਭੇਟਤ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ; ਜਨਮੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਤਾਰਥੁ ਸਫਲੁ ਸਵੇਰਾ ॥੨॥੪॥੧੨੧॥
Meeting the Lord, O Nanak, I have found bliss and peace; my life is fulfilled, and fruitful in good time. ॥2॥4॥121॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਕਿਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਸਾਈ; ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ॥
How may I meet the Lord of the world, O my Lord King?
ਕੋਈ ਐਸਾ ਸੰਤੁ. ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ; ਮੋਹਿ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਦੇਇ ਬਤਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Is there any such saint, the giver of poise and peace, who would show me the way? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
205: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅਲਖੁ. ਨ ਜਾਈ ਲਖਿਆ; ਵਿਚਿ ਪੜਦਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਪਾਈ ॥
The unseen Lord is within, but He cannot be seen; the curtain of ego has been drawn between.
ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਸਭੋ ਜਗੁ ਸੋਇਆ; ਇਹੁ ਭਰਮੁ. ਕਹਹੁ ਕਿਉ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
The whole world is asleep in attachment to Maya; tell me, how can this doubt be dispelled? ॥1॥
ਏਕਾ ਸੰਗਤਿ. ਇਕਤੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਬਸਤੇ; ਮਿਲਿ ਬਾਤ. ਨ ਕਰਤੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
They live in the same company, in the same house, yet they do not speak to each other, O brother.
ਏਕ ਬਸਤੁ ਬਿਨੁ. ਪੰਚ ਦੁਹੇਲੇ; ਓਹ ਬਸਤੁ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਠਾਈ ॥੨॥
Without the one treasure, the five (senses) are miserable; that treasure is in an inaccessible place. ॥2॥
ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ, ਤਿਨਿ ਦੀਆ ਤਾਲਾ; ਕੁੰਜੀ. ਗੁਰ ਸਉਪਾਈ ॥
The One whose house it is has locked it, and given the key to the Guru.
ਅਨਿਕ ਉਪਾਵ ਕਰੇ. ਨਹੀ ਪਾਵੈ; ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੩॥
One may try all sorts of things, but without the sanctuary of the True Guru, He is not found. ॥3॥
ਜਿਨ ਕੇ ਬੰਧਨ. ਕਾਟੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ; ਤਿਨ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
Those whose bonds are cut by the True Guru enshrine love for Him in the holy company.
ਪੰਚ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ. ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਇਆ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ. ਭੇਦੁ ਨ ਭਾਈ ॥੪॥
Their five (senses) join together and sing His praises; O Nanak, there is no difference between them and the Lord, O brother. ॥4॥
ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ; ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥
O my Lord King, in this way the Lord of the world is met.
ਸਹਜੁ ਭਇਆ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਠਾ; ਮਿਲਿ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧॥੧੨੨॥
Poise wells up, doubt runs away in an instant, and one's light merges in the Light. ॥1॥ Second Rahao ॥1॥122॥
Such is the intimacy I have come to have with Him:
ਕਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਦਇਆਲ ਬੀਠੁਲੈ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੁਝਹਿ ਬਤਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
the merciful Lord, beyond Maya, has shown His mercy, and the True Guru has shown me (the way). ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਤ ਕਤ ਦੇਖਉ. ਤਤ ਤਤ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ; ਮੋਹਿ. ਇਹੁ ਬਿਸੁਆਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਆਇਓ ॥
Wherever I look, there I see You; I have come to have this faith.
ਕੈ ਪਹਿ ਕਰਉ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਬੇਨਤੀ; ਜਉ. ਸੁਨਤੋ ਹੈ ਰਘੁਰਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
To whom should I offer my prayer, when the Lord Himself hears it? ॥1॥
ਲਹਿਓ ਸਹਸਾ. ਬੰਧਨ, ਗੁਰਿ ਤੋਰੇ; ਤਾਂ ਸਦਾ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਓ ॥
My anxiety is gone, and the Guru has broken my bonds; then I found lasting poise and peace.
ਹੋਣਾ ਸਾ ਸੋਈ ਫੁਨਿ ਹੋਸੀ; ਸੁਖੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਹਾ ਦਿਖਾਇਓ ॥੨॥
Whatever is to happen shall happen; where then is pain or pleasure to be seen? ॥2॥
ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਕਾ ਏਕੋ ਠਾਣਾ; ਗੁਰਿ. ਪਰਦਾ ਖੋਲਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਓ ॥
The One Lord is the support of all the continents and universes; the Guru has drawn back the curtain and shown Him to me.
ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ, ਇਕ ਠਾਈ; ਤਉ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕੈਠੈ ਜਾਇਓ ॥੩॥
The treasure of the Name, the nine treasures, are in one place (the heart); why then go outside? ॥3॥
ਏਕੈ ਕਨਿਕ ਅਨਿਕ ਭਾਤਿ ਸਾਜੀ; ਬਹੁ ਪਰਕਾਰ ਰਚਾਇਓ ॥
As from one gold many ornaments are fashioned, so He has created the creation in so many ways.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਭਰਮੁ, ਗੁਰਿ ਖੋਈ ਹੈ; ਇਵ ਤਤੈ ਤਤੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਓ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੨੩॥
Says Nanak, the Guru has dispelled my doubt; in this way, the essence merges with the Essence. ॥4॥2॥123॥
Day and night, your life is waning.
ਮਨ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ; ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O mind, meeting the Guru, resolve your affairs. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਕਰਉ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ. ਸੁਨਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤਾ; ਸੰਤ ਟਹਲ ਕੀ ਬੇਲਾ ॥
I offer this prayer: hear me, O my friend — now is the time to serve the saints.
ਈਹਾ. ਖਾਟਿ ਚਲਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਹਾ; ਆਗੈ ਬਸਨੁ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ॥੧॥
Earn the profit of the Lord here, and depart; hereafter, your dwelling shall be peaceful. ॥1॥
ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਬਿਕਾਰੁ ਸਹਸੇ ਮਹਿ; ਤਰਿਓ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ॥
This world is corrupt, sunk in anxiety; the one who knows God crosses over.
ਜਿਸਹਿ ਜਗਾਇ ਪੀਆਏ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ; ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਜਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
The one whom He awakens and makes to drink His essence knows the story of the Indescribable. ॥2॥
ਜਾ ਕਉ ਆਏ. ਸੋਈ ਵਿਹਾਝਹੁ; ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮਨਹਿ ਬਸੇਰਾ ॥
Purchase that for which you have come; through the Guru, the Lord comes to dwell in the mind.
ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜੇ; ਬਹੁਰਿ. ਨ ਹੋਇਗੋ ਫੇਰਾ ॥੩॥
Within your own home, you shall find the mansion of His presence, with poise and peace; you shall not be cast into the cycle again. ॥3॥
ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਪੁਰਖ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ; ਸਰਧਾ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
O Searcher of hearts, Primal Being, Architect of destiny, fulfil the longing of my mind.
ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸੁ. ਇਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਾਗੈ; ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕਰਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਰੇ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੨੪॥
Slave Nanak begs for this happiness: make me the dust of the feet of the saints. ॥4॥3॥124॥
Save me, O God, my Father.
ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਨੁ; ਸਭ ਗੁਨ ਤੇਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I am without virtue; all virtues are Yours. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਪੰਚ ਬਿਖਾਦੀ. ਏਕੁ ਗਰੀਬਾ; ਰਾਖਹੁ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੇ ॥
The five quarrelsome ones are against me, poor and alone; save me, O Saviour Lord.
ਖੇਦੁ ਕਰਹਿ. ਅਰੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਸੰਤਾਵਹਿ; ਆਇਓ ਸਰਨਿ ਤੁਹਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
They harass and torment me greatly; I have come to Your sanctuary. ॥1॥
206: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਹਾਰਿਓ. ਅਨਿਕ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤੀ; ਛੋਡਹਿ ਕਤਹੂੰ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
I have grown weary trying so many things; they do not leave me at all.
ਏਕ ਬਾਤ ਸੁਨਿ. ਤਾਕੀ ਓਟਾ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਟਿ ਜਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
I have heard that they can be eradicated in the holy company, and so I have taken its shelter. ॥2॥
ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸੰਤ ਮਿਲੇ ਮੋਹਿ; ਤਿਨ ਤੇ. ਧੀਰਜੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
In Your mercy, I have met the saints, and from them I have received courage.
ਸੰਤੀ. ਮੰਤੁ ਦੀਓ ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਭਉ; ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
The saints have given me the mantra of the Fearless Lord, and I have practised the Guru's Word. ॥3॥
ਜੀਤਿ ਲਏ ਓਇ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖਾਦੀ; ਸਹਜ ਸੁਹੇਲੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
I have now conquered those great evil-doers, through the sweet, poised Word.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਮਨਿ ਭਇਆ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ; ਪਾਇਆ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੨੫॥
Says Nanak, the light has dawned in my mind; I have attained the state beyond desire. ॥4॥4॥125॥
ਨਿਰਭਉ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੈ ਬਸਤੇ; ਇਹੁ ਡਰਨੁ. ਕਹਾ ਤੇ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Those who dwell with You are fearless; where then could fear come from? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਏਕ ਮਹਲਿ. ਤੂੰ ਹੋਹਿ ਅਫਾਰੋ; ਏਕ ਮਹਲਿ ਨਿਮਾਨੋ ॥
In one body You are proud, and in another You are humble.
ਏਕ ਮਹਲਿ. ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ; ਏਕ ਮਹਲਿ ਗਰੀਬਾਨੋ ॥੧॥
In one body You are all-powerful, and in another You are poor. ॥1॥
ਏਕ ਮਹਲਿ. ਤੂੰ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਬਕਤਾ; ਏਕ ਮਹਲਿ ਖਲੁ ਹੋਤਾ ॥
In one body You are a learned pandit and preacher, and in another You are a fool.
ਏਕ ਮਹਲਿ. ਤੂੰ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਗ੍ਰਾਹਜੁ; ਏਕ ਮਹਲਿ. ਕਛੂ ਨ ਲੇਤਾ ॥੨॥
In one body You grasp everything, and in another You accept nothing. ॥2॥
ਕਾਠ ਕੀ ਪੁਤਰੀ. ਕਹਾ ਕਰੈ ਬਪੁਰੀ; ਖਿਲਾਵਨਹਾਰੋ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
What can the poor wooden puppet do? The Master Puppeteer knows all.
ਜੈਸਾ ਭੇਖੁ. ਕਰਾਵੈ ਬਾਜੀਗਰੁ; ਓਹੁ. ਤੈਸੋ ਹੀ ਸਾਜੁ ਆਨੈ ॥੩॥
As the Puppeteer dresses the puppet, so is the role it plays. ॥3॥
ਅਨਿਕ ਕੋਠਰੀ. ਬਹੁਤੁ ਭਾਤਿ ਕਰੀਆ; ਆਪਿ ਹੋਆ ਰਖਵਾਰਾ ॥
The Lord has created many chambers of various kinds, and He Himself is their protector.
ਜੈਸੇ ਮਹਲਿ ਰਾਖੈ. ਤੈਸੈ ਰਹਨਾ; ਕਿਆ ਇਹੁ ਕਰੈ ਬਿਚਾਰਾ ॥੪॥
As He places the soul, so must it dwell; what can this poor creature do? ॥4॥
ਜਿਨਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਆ. ਸੋਈ ਜਾਨੈ; ਜਿਨਿ ਇਹ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਸਾਜੀ ॥
He who created everything knows it; He fashioned this whole creation.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਕੀਮਤਿ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਾਜੀ ॥੫॥੫॥੧੨੬॥
Says Nanak, the Lord and Master is infinite; He alone knows the worth of His works. ॥5॥5॥126॥
ਛੋਡਿ ਛੋਡਿ ਰੇ; ਬਿਖਿਆ ਕੇ ਰਸੂਆ ॥
Give up, give up the pleasures of Maya.
ਉਰਝਿ ਰਹਿਓ. ਰੇ ਬਾਵਰ ਗਾਵਰ; ਜਿਉ ਕਿਰਖੈ. ਹਰਿਆਇਓ ਪਸੂਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
You are entangled in them, you mad fool, like an animal grazing in a green field. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜੋ ਜਾਨਹਿ. ਤੂੰ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਾਜੈ; ਸੋ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਚਾਲੈ ਤੇਰੈ. ਤਸੂਆ ॥
What you believe to be of use to you shall not go with you, even a tiny bit.
ਨਾਗੋ ਆਇਓ. ਨਾਗ ਸਿਧਾਸੀ; ਫੇਰਿ ਫਿਰਿਓ. ਅਰੁ ਕਾਲਿ ਗਰਸੂਆ ॥੧॥
Naked you came, and naked you shall depart; you wander in the cycle, consumed by death. ॥1॥
ਪੇਖਿ ਪੇਖਿ ਰੇ. ਕਸੁੰਭ ਕੀ ਲੀਲਾ; ਰਾਚਿ ਮਾਚਿ ਤਿਨਹੂੰ ਲਉ ਹਸੂਆ ॥
Beholding the fleeting play of the safflower, you are engrossed and laugh at it.
ਛੀਜਤ ਡੋਰਿ. ਦਿਨਸੁ ਅਰੁ ਰੈਨੀ; ਜੀਅ ਕੋ ਕਾਜੁ. ਨ ਕੀਨੋ ਕਛੂਆ ॥੨॥
The thread of life is wearing away night and day, and you have done nothing for your soul. ॥2॥
ਕਰਤ ਕਰਤ. ਇਵ ਹੀ ਬਿਰਧਾਨੋ; ਹਾਰਿਓ ਉਕਤੇ, ਤਨੁ ਖੀਨਸੂਆ ॥
Doing and doing (worldly deeds), one grows old; the intellect fails and the body withers.
ਜਿਉ ਮੋਹਿਓ. ਉਨਿ ਮੋਹਨੀ ਬਾਲਾ; ਉਸ ਤੇ. ਘਟੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਰੁਚ ਚਸੂਆ ॥੩॥
As he was enticed by that enticing (Maya) in youth, his fondness for her does not diminish one bit. ॥3॥
ਜਗੁ ਐਸਾ. ਮੋਹਿ ਗੁਰਹਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਓ; ਤਉ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰਿਓ, ਤਜਿ ਗਰਬਸੂਆ ॥
The Guru has shown me that the world is like this; so I have renounced pride and entered His sanctuary.
ਮਾਰਗੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੋ. ਸੰਤਿ ਬਤਾਇਓ; ਦ੍ਰਿੜੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ. ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੂਆ ॥੪॥੬॥੧੨੭॥
The saint has shown me the path to God; slave Nanak has implanted devotion and the Lord's praises within. ॥4॥6॥127॥
O my Beloved, You are the support of my breath of life. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਅੰਤਰ ਕੀ ਬਿਧਿ. ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਜਾਨੀ; ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਸਜਨ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ॥
You alone know the state of my inner being; You alone are my friend and comforter.
ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਮੈ ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਪਾਏ; ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਅਗਹ ਅਤੋਲੇ ॥੧॥
I have received all comforts from You, O my unfathomable, immeasurable Lord and Master. ॥1॥
207: ਬਰਨਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਉ. ਤੁਮਰੇ ਰੰਗਾ; ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ॥
I cannot describe Your wondrous plays, O Treasure of virtue, Giver of peace.
ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ; ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ. ਜਾਤੇ ॥੨॥
O inaccessible, unfathomable, imperishable God, You are known through the Perfect Guru. ॥2॥
ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਕਾਟਿ. ਕੀਏ ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲ; ਜਬ ਤੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀ ॥
My doubt and fear have been cut away, and I have been made pure, since my ego was subdued.
ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਕੋ ਚੂਕੋ ਸਹਸਾ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਦਰਸਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
The fear of birth and death is gone, through the Blessed Vision in the holy company. ॥3॥
ਚਰਣ ਪਖਾਰਿ. ਕਰਉ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ; ਬਾਰਿ ਜਾਉ ਲਖ ਬਰੀਆ ॥
I wash the Guru's feet and serve Him; I am a sacrifice to Him hundreds of thousands of times.
ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ. ਇਹੁ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਤਰਿਆ; ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਰੀਆ ॥੪॥੭॥੧੨੮॥
By His grace, servant Nanak has crossed over this terrifying world-ocean, and is united with his Beloved. ॥4॥7॥128॥
Who but You can please You?
ਤੇਰੋ ਰੂਪੁ; ਸਗਲ ਦੇਖਿ ਮੋਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Gazing upon Your form, all are fascinated. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸੁਰਗ ਪਇਆਲ ਮਿਰਤ ਭੂਅ ਮੰਡਲ; ਸਰਬ ਸਮਾਨੋ ਏਕੈ ਓਹੀ ॥
In heaven, in the underworld, in this mortal world and in all the realms, the One Lord alone is pervading.
ਸਿਵ ਸਿਵ ਕਰਤ, ਸਗਲ ਕਰ ਜੋਰਹਿ; ਸਰਬ ਮਇਆ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਤੇਰੀ ਦੋਹੀ ॥੧॥
Calling upon You as the Benevolent One, all join their palms together; O merciful Lord and Master, they cry out to You for help. ॥1॥
ਪਤਿਤ. ਪਾਵਨ, ਠਾਕੁਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਮਰਾ; ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੀਤਲੋਹੀ ॥
O Lord and Master, Your Name is the Purifier of sinners; You are the Giver of peace, immaculate, cool and calm.
ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਵਡਿਆਈ; ਸੰਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਸਿਉ ਗਾਲ ਗਲੋਹੀ ॥੨॥੮॥੧੨੯॥
O Nanak, spiritual wisdom, meditation and glory come from the conversation of Your saints about You. ॥2॥8॥129॥
Meet me, O my Beloved, (O Lover of all beings).
O God, whatever You do — that alone happens. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਅਨਿਕ ਜਨਮ ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨੀ ਭ੍ਰਮਿਆ; ਬਹੁਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Wandering through so many births and species, one suffers pain again and again.
ਤੁਮਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ. ਮਾਨੁਖ ਦੇਹ ਪਾਈ ਹੈ; ਦੇਹੁ ਦਰਸੁ. ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
By Your grace, I have obtained this human body; grant me Your Blessed Vision, O Lord King. ॥1॥
ਸੋਈ ਹੋਆ. ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ; ਅਵਰੁ. ਨ ਕਿਨ ਹੀ ਕੀਤਾ ॥
That alone happens which pleases Him; no one else can do anything.
ਤੁਮਰੈ ਭਾਣੈ. ਭਰਮਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਮੋਹਿਆ; ਜਾਗਤੁ ਨਾਹੀ. ਸੂਤਾ ॥੨॥
By Your will, one is enticed by doubt and attachment; asleep, he does not wake up. ॥2॥
ਬਿਨਉ ਸੁਨਹੁ. ਤੁਮ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ; ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
Hear my prayer, O Beloved Master of my breath of life, merciful Treasure of mercy.
ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ. ਪਿਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ; ਅਨਾਥਹ ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥੩॥
Save me, O God, my Father; I am an orphan — please cherish me. ॥3॥
ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੁਮਹਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਓ ਦਰਸਨੁ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੈ ਪਾਛੈ ॥
Those to whom You have shown Your Blessed Vision, You have shown it through the holy company.
ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧੂਰਿ ਦੇਹੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ; ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ. ਇਹੁ ਬਾਛੈ ॥੪॥੯॥੧੩੦॥
Grant Your grace and bless me with the dust of the feet of the saints; Nanak longs for this happiness. ॥4॥9॥130॥
I am a sacrifice to those
ਜਾ ਕੈ; ਕੇਵਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
who take the Name alone as their support. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਮਹਿਮਾ ਤਾ ਕੀ. ਕੇਤਕ ਗਨੀਐ; ਜਨ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
How can I count their glories? His humble servants are imbued with the love of the Supreme Lord God.
ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਤਿਨਾ ਸੰਗਿ; ਉਨ ਸਮਸਰਿ. ਅਵਰ ਨ ਦਾਤੇ ॥੧॥
Peace, poise and bliss are with them; there is no other giver equal to them. ॥1॥
ਜਗਤ ਉਧਾਰਣ ਸੇਈ ਆਏ; ਜੋ ਜਨ ਦਰਸ ਪਿਆਸਾ ॥
They have come to save the world, those humble beings who thirst for His Blessed Vision.
ਉਨ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੈ. ਸੋ ਤਰਿਆ; ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ. ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸਾ ॥੨॥
One who seeks their sanctuary is carried across; in the company of the saints, all hopes are fulfilled. ॥2॥
ਤਾ ਕੈ ਚਰਣਿ ਪਰਉ. ਤਾ ਜੀਵਾ; ਜਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਾ ॥
If I fall at their feet, then I live; in the company of His humble servants, I am in bliss.
ਭਗਤਨ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁ. ਹੋਇ ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ; ਹੋਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ॥੩॥
May my mind become the dust of the feet of His devotees; be merciful, O God. ॥3॥
ਰਾਜੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ. ਅਵਧ ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ; ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ. ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਘਾਟਿਆ ॥
Power, youth, life-span — all that is seen — all this diminishes in this world.
ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ. ਸਦ ਨਵਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ; ਇਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਖਾਟਿਆ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੧੩੧॥
The treasure of the Name is ever new and pure; Nanak has earned this wealth of the Lord. ॥4॥10॥131॥
208: ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ; ਸੁਨਿ ਆਇਓ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ॥
I have come, having heard from the Guru the way of true Yoga.
ਮੋ ਕਉ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ. ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The True Guru has revealed it to me through the Word. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਨਉ ਖੰਡ ਪ੍ਰਿਥਮੀ. ਇਸੁ ਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਰਵਿਆ; ਨਿਮਖ ਨਿਮਖ ਨਮਸਕਾਰਾ ॥
He is pervading the nine continents of the world, and within this body; each and every moment I bow to Him.
ਦੀਖਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ. ਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਕਾਨੀ; ਦ੍ਰਿੜਿਓ ਏਕੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
I have made the Guru's teaching my earrings, and enshrined the One Formless Lord within me. ॥1॥
ਪੰਚ ਚੇਲੇ ਮਿਲਿ. ਭਏ ਇਕਤ੍ਰਾ; ਏਕਸੁ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਕੀਏ ॥
The five disciples (the senses) have joined together and been brought under the control of one (higher awareness).
ਦਸ ਬੈਰਾਗਨਿ ਆਗਿਆਕਾਰੀ; ਤਬ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੋਗੀ ਥੀਏ ॥੨॥
When the ten (organs) became renunciates, obedient (to it), then I became a pure yogi. ॥2॥
ਭਰਮੁ ਜਰਾਇ. ਚਰਾਈ ਬਿਭੂਤਾ; ਪੰਥੁ ਏਕੁ ਕਰਿ ਪੇਖਿਆ ॥
I have burnt away my doubt and smeared its ashes on my body; my path is to see the One Lord everywhere.
ਸਹਜ ਸੂਖ. ਸੋ ਕੀਨੀ ਭੁਗਤਾ; ਜੋ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ. ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇਖਿਆ ॥੩॥
I have made peace and poise my food, which my Lord and Master wrote on my forehead. ॥3॥
ਜਹ ਭਉ ਨਾਹੀ. ਤਹਾ ਆਸਨੁ ਬਾਧਿਓ; ਸਿੰਗੀ ਅਨਹਤ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
Where there is no fear, there I have set up my seat; the unstruck melody of the Word is my horn.
ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ. ਡੰਡਾ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਓ; ਜੁਗਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਨੀ ॥੪॥
I have made contemplation of the essence my staff; love of the Name is the way of life pleasing to my mind. ॥4॥
ਐਸਾ ਜੋਗੀ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਭੇਟੈ; ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟੈ ॥
By great good fortune one meets such a yogi, who cuts away the bonds of Maya.
ਸੇਵਾ ਪੂਜ ਕਰਉ. ਤਿਸੁ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਕੀ; ਨਾਨਕੁ. ਤਿਸੁ ਪਗ ਚਾਟੈ ॥੫॥੧੧॥੧੩੨॥
Nanak serves and adores this wondrous being, and kisses his feet. ॥5॥11॥132॥
ਅਨੂਪ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ. ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ; ਸਗਲ ਧਿਆਇਲੇ ਮੀਤਾ ॥
Hear of the incomparable treasure of the Name; let everyone meditate on it, O friends.
ਹਰਿ ਅਉਖਧੁ. ਜਾ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ; ਤਾ ਕੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਚੀਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Those to whom the Guru has given the medicine of the Lord — their minds become pure. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਅੰਧਕਾਰੁ ਮਿਟਿਓ. ਤਿਹ ਤਨ ਤੇ; ਗੁਰਿ. ਸਬਦਿ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ॥
Darkness is dispelled from the body of the one within whom the Guru has lit the lamp of the Word.
ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕੀ ਜਾਲੀ. ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕਾਟੀ; ਜਾ ਕਉ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸਾ ॥੧॥
The net of doubt is cut away for one who has faith in the holy company. ॥1॥
ਤਾਰੀਲੇ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਾਰੂ ਬਿਖੜਾ; ਬੋਹਿਥ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਾ ॥
The terrifying, treacherous world-ocean is crossed over in the boat of the holy company.
ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਈ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਆਸਾ; ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਾ ॥੨॥
The hopes of my mind are fulfilled, meeting the Guru, who is imbued with the Lord's love. ॥2॥
ਨਾਮ ਖਜਾਨਾ. ਭਗਤੀ ਪਾਇਆ; ਮਨ ਤਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਏ ॥
The devotees have found the treasure of the Name; their minds and bodies are satisfied and fulfilled.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਦੇਵੈ; ਜਾ ਕਉ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮਨਾਏ ॥੩॥੧੨॥੧੩੩॥
O Nanak, the Dear Lord gives it to those whom He inspires to obey His command. ॥3॥12॥133॥
ਦਇਆ ਮਇਆ ਕਰਿ. ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤਿ ਮੋਰੇ; ਮੋਹਿ ਅਨਾਥ. ਸਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੋਰੀ ॥
Show kindness and compassion, O Master of my breath of life; I am helpless, and I seek Your sanctuary, O God.
ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਮਹਿ ਹਾਥ ਦੇ ਰਾਖਹੁ; ਕਛੂ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਉਕਤਿ ਨ ਮੋਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Give me Your hand and save me from the deep dark well; I have no cleverness or argument of my own. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ; ਤੁਮ ਸਮਰਥ. ਨਾਹੀ ਅਨ ਹੋਰੀ ॥
You are the Doer, the Cause of causes — You are everything; You are all-powerful, there is no other at all.
ਤੁਮਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ. ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਜਾਨੀ; ਸੇ ਸੇਵਕ. ਜਿਨ ਭਾਗ ਮਥੋਰੀ ॥੧॥
You alone know Your state and extent; they alone become Your servants who have such destiny on their foreheads. ॥1॥
ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਸੰਗਿ. ਤੁਮ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਤੇ; ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਭਗਤਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਜੋਰੀ ॥
You, O God, are imbued with Your servants; You are joined with Your devotees through and through.
ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਨਾਮੁ. ਤੇਰਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਚਾਹੈ; ਜੈਸੇ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ. ਓਹ ਚੰਦ ਚਕੋਰੀ ॥੨॥
Calling on the Name, "Beloved, Beloved," they long for Your Blessed Vision, as the chakor longs to see the moon. ॥2॥
ਰਾਮ ਸੰਤ ਮਹਿ. ਭੇਦੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ; ਏਕੁ ਜਨੁ. ਕਈ ਮਹਿ ਲਾਖ ਕਰੋਰੀ ॥
There is no difference between the Lord and His saint; but such a humble being is one among many hundreds of thousands and millions.
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹੀਐ. ਪ੍ਰਗਟੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹੋਆ; ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ. ਰਸਨ ਰਮੋਰੀ ॥੩॥
One within whose heart God is revealed chants His praises with his tongue night and day. ॥3॥
ਤੁਮ ਸਮਰਥ ਅਪਾਰ ਅਤਿ ਊਚੇ; ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧੋਰੀ ॥
You are all-powerful and infinite, most lofty, the Giver of peace, O God, the support of the breath of life.
ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ. ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀਜੈ ਕਿਰਪਾ; ਉਨ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੰਗੋਰੀ ॥੪॥੧੩॥੧੩੪॥
O God, show mercy to Nanak, and keep him in the company of those saints. ॥4॥13॥134॥
209: You are imbued with the Lord, O saints.
ਨਿਬਾਹਿ ਲੇਹੁ. ਮੋ ਕਉ ਪੁਰਖ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ; ਓੜਿ ਪਹੁਚਾਵਹੁ ਦਾਤੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O Primal Being, Architect of destiny, stand by me to the end; carry me through to the very end, O Giver. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਤੁਮਰਾ ਮਰਮੁ. ਤੁਮਾ ਹੀ ਜਾਨਿਆ; ਤੁਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੁਰਖ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ ॥
You alone know Your mystery; You are the Perfect Being, the Architect of destiny.
ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸਰਣਿ. ਅਨਾਥ ਦੀਨ ਕਉ; ਕਰਹੁ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਗਾਤੇ ॥੧॥
Keep me, helpless and meek, in Your sanctuary; save me. ॥1॥
ਤਰਣ ਸਾਗਰ ਬੋਹਿਥ ਚਰਣ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ; ਤੁਮ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਭਾਤੇ ॥
To cross over the world-ocean, Your feet are the boat; You alone know Your ways.
ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ. ਜਿਸੁ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸੰਗੇ; ਤੇ ਤੇ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਾਤੇ ॥੨॥
Those whom You, in Your mercy, keep with You are carried across. ॥2॥
ਈਤ ਊਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮ ਸਮਰਥਾ; ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੁਮਰੈ ਹਾਥੇ ॥
Here and hereafter, O God, You are all-powerful; everything is in Your hands.
ਐਸਾ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਮੋ ਕਉ. ਹਰਿ ਜਨ; ਚਲੈ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਸਾਥੇ ॥੩॥
O humble servants of the Lord, give me such a treasure, which will go along with me. ॥3॥
ਨਿਰਗੁਨੀਆਰੇ ਕਉ ਗੁਨੁ ਕੀਜੈ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ. ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਜਾਪੇ ॥
Bless me, the worthless one, with this virtue: that my mind may chant the Lord's Name.
ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ. ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਭੇਟੇ; ਮਨ ਤਨ ਸੀਤਲ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੇ ॥੪॥੧੪॥੧੩੫॥
By the grace of the saints, Nanak has met the Lord; his mind and body are soothed and satisfied. ॥4॥14॥135॥
I am absorbed in poise, O Divine Lord;
ਮੋ ਕਉ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲ ਦੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
the True Guru has become merciful to me, O Divine Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਕਾਟਿ ਜੇਵਰੀ. ਕੀਓ ਦਾਸਰੋ; ਸੰਤਨ ਟਹਲਾਇਓ ॥
Cutting away my noose, He has made me His slave, and put me to the service of the saints.
ਏਕ ਨਾਮ ਕੋ. ਥੀਓ ਪੂਜਾਰੀ; ਮੋ ਕਉ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਗੁਰਹਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
I have become a worshipper of the One Name; the Guru has shown me the wonder (of the Lord). ॥1॥
ਭਇਓ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਸਰਬ ਉਜੀਆਰਾ; ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਮਨਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਇਓ ॥
The light has dawned, and everything is illumined; the Guru's spiritual wisdom has been revealed in my mind.
ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੀਓ. ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿਆ; ਅਨਭੈ ਠਹਰਾਇਓ ॥੨॥
Drinking in the Ambrosial Name, my mind is satisfied, and I am settled in the Fearless Lord. ॥2॥
ਮਾਨਿ ਆਗਿਆ. ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਏ; ਦੂਖਹ ਠਾਉ ਗਵਾਇਓ ॥
Accepting His command, I have found all peace, and the home of pain has been destroyed.
ਜਉ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਭਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਠਾਕੁਰ; ਸਭੁ ਆਨਦ ਰੂਪੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਓ ॥੩॥
When God, my Lord and Master, became pleased, He revealed everything to be the form of bliss. ॥3॥
ਨਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਵਤ. ਨਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਵਤ; ਸਭੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਕੀਓ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਓ ॥
Nothing comes and nothing goes; all this is the play set in motion by the Lord King.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਅਗਮ ਅਗਮ ਹੈ ਠਾਕੁਰ; ਭਗਤ ਟੇਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇਓ ॥੪॥੧੫॥੧੩੬॥
Says Nanak, our Lord and Master is inaccessible, inaccessible; the Lord's Name is the support of His devotees. ॥4॥15॥136॥
ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ; ਮਨ. ਤਾ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਗਹੀਜੈ ਰੇ ॥
O mind, grasp the support of the Supreme Lord God, the Perfect Transcendent Lord.
ਜਿਨਿ ਧਾਰੇ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਖੰਡ ਹਰਿ; ਤਾ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀਜੈ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Chant the Name of the Lord who upholds the worlds and continents. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਤਿਆਗਹੁ. ਹਰਿ ਜਨ; ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੂਝਿ. ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਰੇ ॥
Renounce the cleverness of your mind, O humble servants of the Lord; understanding His command, peace is found.
ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਰੈ. ਸੋਈ ਭਲ ਮਾਨਹੁ; ਸੁਖਿ ਦੁਖਿ ਓਹੀ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
Whatever God does, accept that as good; in pleasure and in pain, meditate on Him. ॥1॥
ਕੋਟਿ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰੇ. ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ; ਕਰਤੇ ਬਾਰ. ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਰੇ ॥
The Creator saves millions of sinners in an instant, without a moment's delay.
ਦੀਨ ਦਰਦ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ. ਤਿਸਹਿ ਨਿਵਾਜੈ ਰੇ ॥੨॥
The Lord, the Destroyer of the pain and sorrow of the meek, blesses whomever He pleases. ॥2॥
ਸਭ ਕੋ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਕ; ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਰੇ ॥
He is the Mother and Father, the Cherisher of all, the Ocean of peace for soul and breath.
ਦੇਂਦੇ ਤੋਟਿ ਨਾਹੀ. ਤਿਸੁ ਕਰਤੇ; ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ. ਰਤਨਾਗਰੁ ਰੇ ॥੩॥
Giving, the Creator does not run short of anything; the Treasure of jewels is pervading everywhere. ॥3॥
ਜਾਚਿਕੁ ਜਾਚੈ. ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੋਈ ਰੇ ॥
The beggar begs for Your Name, O Lord and Master; He alone is within each and every heart.
ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸੁ. ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ; ਜਾ ਤੇ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ. ਨ ਕੋਈ ਰੇ ॥੪॥੧੬॥੧੩੭॥
Slave Nanak has entered His sanctuary, from whom no one returns empty-handed. ॥4॥16॥137॥
210: One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ; ਕਬਹੂ. ਨ ਮਨਹੁ ਬਿਸਾਰੇ ॥
Never forget the Lord from your mind.
ਈਹਾ ਊਹਾ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ; ਸਗਲ ਘਟਾ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Here and hereafter, He is the Giver of all peace; He cherishes all hearts. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਮਹਾ ਕਸਟ ਕਾਟੈ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ; ਰਸਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਚਿਤਾਰੇ ॥
He removes the greatest suffering in an instant of one who remembers the Name with the tongue.
ਸੀਤਲ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸੂਖ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣੀ; ਜਲਤੀ ਅਗਨਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
In the Lord's sanctuary there is cooling calm, peace and comfort; He puts out the burning fire (of craving). ॥1॥
ਗਰਭ ਕੁੰਡ ਨਰਕ ਤੇ ਰਾਖੈ; ਭਵਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੇ ॥
He saves one from the hell of the womb, and carries one across the world-ocean.
ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਆਰਾਧਤ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ; ਜਮ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਬਿਦਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
Worshipping His lotus feet in the mind, the fear of death is dispelled. ॥2॥
ਪੂਰਨ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ; ਊਚਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੇ ॥
The Supreme Lord God is all-pervading, most lofty, inaccessible and infinite.
ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਤ. ਧਿਆਵਤ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ; ਜੂਏ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਹਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
Singing His praises and meditating on the Ocean of peace, one does not lose life in a gamble. ॥3॥
ਕਾਮਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਲੋਭਿ ਮੋਹਿ. ਮਨੁ ਲੀਨੋ; ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਕੇ ਦਾਤਾਰੇ ॥
My mind is caught in lust, anger, greed and attachment, O Giver to the worthless.
ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪੁਨੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਜੈ; ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੩੮॥
Grant Your grace and bless me with Your Name; Nanak is forever a sacrifice to You. ॥4॥1॥138॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਰੇ; ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਿਨਾ ॥
There is no peace without devotion to the Lord.
ਜੀਤਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਇਹੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਅਮੋਲਕੁ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ, ਜਪਿ ਇਕ ਖਿਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Win this priceless jewel of human life: in the holy company, meditate on Him every moment. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Children, wealth, the delights of a wife —
many people have left such pleasures behind and gone. ॥1॥
Fine horses, elephants and the pleasures of power —
leaving them behind, the fool departs naked. ॥2॥
One prides oneself on a body anointed with perfume and sandalwood,
yet that body rolls in the dust. ॥3॥
Enticed by attachment, one thinks the Lord is far away.
Says Nanak, He is ever present. ॥4॥1॥139॥
ਮਨ ਧਰ ਤਰਬੇ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਨੋ ॥
O mind, the Lord's Name is the support for crossing over.
ਸਾਗਰ ਲਹਰਿ. ਸੰਸਾ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ; ਗੁਰੁ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਪਾਰ ਗਰਾਮਨੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The world is an ocean of waves of anxiety; the Guru is the ship that carries one across. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The strife of the world is a blackness that brings darkness;
the Guru's wisdom is the lamp that gives light. ॥1॥
The poison of Maya is spread far and wide, very dense;
only by meditating on the Lord's virtues are people saved. ॥2॥
Intoxicated with Maya, one stays asleep;
meeting the Guru, doubt and fear are dispelled. ॥3॥
Says Nanak, one who meditates on the One Lord
sees Him in each and every heart. ॥4॥2॥140॥
You alone are my support, O Lord.
Taking the Guru's shelter, I serve You. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
By countless methods I could not find You;
the Guru has made me Your servant and attached me to You. ॥1॥
I have slain the five troublemakers;
by the Guru's grace, I have conquered their army. ॥2॥
One who receives the One Name as a gift and a reward
dwells in peace, poise and bliss. ॥3॥
